page_description: Bring unread Miniflux articles to your Kobo and keep reading without Wi-Fi.
release_notes: Rebuilt on a renderer that keeps every control reachable at the largest text sizes, and on a keyboard that can type every character this app asks for.

steps.text: Have an HTTPS Miniflux instance, either self-hosted or hosted, and create an API token.
Install the token under the exact name miniflux; the runtime sends it as X-Auth-Token.

user: Somebody who follows feeds and wants them away from the phone.
job: Read your Miniflux feeds on e-ink, anywhere.
offline: Entries already fetched work without the network; refreshing does not.

data.kind: the entries already fetched and your pending marks
data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; marks send when the network returns

capabilities_required.name: network
capabilities_required.purpose: to refresh your Miniflux feeds and send your marks

non_goals: It does not fetch full articles beyond the feed.
